attributes.name: Black Dragonhide Breastplate
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card reduce Acid or Combat damage dealt to you by 2, or to reduce damage dealt to you by a bane that has the Dragon trait by 4. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, bury it instead. 

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
